{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Crypto.MultiTenant.KeyStore where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Char (ord, isAscii)
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- | Tenant key store with cryptographic isolation
type TenantId = Text
type KeyMaterial = BS.ByteString

data KeyEntry = KeyEntry
  { keOwner    :: !TenantId
  , keMaterial :: !KeyMaterial
  , keScope    :: !AccessScope
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data AccessScope = ScopeTenant | ScopeShared | ScopeAdmin
  deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

-- Global key store (in production, this would be in a secure enclave)
{-# NOINLINE globalStore #-}
globalStore :: IORef (Map.Map Text KeyEntry)
globalStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

-- | Normalize tenant identifier for consistent lookup
-- Uses NFKC normalization to prevent homograph attacks
normalizeTenantId :: Text -> Text
normalizeTenantId tid = 
  let -- Strip leading/trailing whitespace
      stripped = T.strip tid
      -- Convert to lowercase for case-insensitive comparison
      lowered = T.toLower stripped
      -- Apply compatibility decomposition
      decomposed = decomposeCompat lowered
  in decomposed

-- | Compatibility decomposition mapping
-- Maps visually similar Unicode characters to their ASCII equivalents
decomposeCompat :: Text -> Text
decomposeCompat = T.concatMap decomposeChar

-- | Decompose individual characters
-- This handles common homoglyphs used in attacks
decomposeChar :: Char -> Text
decomposeChar c
  | c == '\x0430' = T.singleton 'a'  -- Cyrillic а -> Latin a
  | c == '\x0435' = T.singleton 'e'  -- Cyrillic е -> Latin e
  | c == '\x043E' = T.singleton 'o'  -- Cyrillic о -> Latin o
  | c == '\x0440' = T.singleton 'p'  -- Cyrillic р -> Latin p
  | c == '\x0441' = T.singleton 'c'  -- Cyrillic с -> Latin c
  | c == '\x0443' = T.singleton 'y'  -- Cyrillic у -> Latin y
  | c == '\x0445' = T.singleton 'x'  -- Cyrillic х -> Latin x
  | c == '\x0455' = T.singleton 's'  -- Cyrillic ѕ -> Latin s
  | c == '\x0456' = T.singleton 'i'  -- Cyrillic і -> Latin i
  | c == '\x0458' = T.singleton 'j'  -- Cyrillic ј -> Latin j
  | c == '\xFF41' = T.singleton 'a'  -- Fullwidth a -> Latin a
  | c == '\xFF45' = T.singleton 'e'  -- Fullwidth e -> Latin e
  | c == '\x01B0' = T.singleton 'u'  -- Latin ư -> u
  | otherwise     = T.singleton c

-- | Validate that a tenant ID contains only safe characters
-- BEFORE normalization - reject any non-ASCII input outright
validateTenantId :: Text -> Either Text Text
validateTenantId raw =
  let stripped = T.strip raw
  in if T.all isAscii stripped  -- Reject non-ASCII BEFORE normalization
        && T.all isSafeIdChar (T.toLower stripped)
        && T.length stripped > 0
        && T.length stripped <= 64
     then Right (T.toLower stripped)
     else Left "Invalid tenant identifier: only ASCII alphanumeric, dash, underscore, dot allowed"

isSafeIdChar :: Char -> Bool
isSafeIdChar c = isAscii c && (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' 
                            || c >= '0' && c <= '9'
                            || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.')

-- | Register a new key for a tenant
registerKey :: TenantId -> KeyMaterial -> AccessScope -> IO (Either Text ())
registerKey rawTid material scope = do
  case validateTenantId rawTid of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right normalizedTid -> do
      let entry = KeyEntry normalizedTid material scope
      atomicModifyIORef' globalStore $ \store ->
        (Map.insert normalizedTid entry store, ())
      return $ Right ()

-- | Retrieve a key, enforcing tenant isolation
-- The requesting tenant must match the key owner
retrieveKey :: TenantId -> TenantId -> IO (Either Text KeyMaterial)
retrieveKey requestorRaw targetKeyTid = do
  case (validateTenantId requestorRaw, validateTenantId targetKeyTid) of
    (Right reqNorm, Right targetNorm) -> do
      store <- readIORef globalStore
      case Map.lookup targetNorm store of
        Nothing -> return $ Left "Key not found"
        Just entry
          | keOwner entry == reqNorm -> return $ Right (keMaterial entry)
          | keScope entry == ScopeShared -> return $ Right (keMaterial entry)
          | otherwise -> return $ Left "Access denied: tenant isolation violation"
    _ -> return $ Left "Invalid tenant identifier"

-- | Cross-tenant key derivation with isolation check
-- Derives a shared key between two tenants using their respective materials
deriveSharedKey :: TenantId -> TenantId -> IO (Either Text KeyMaterial)
deriveSharedKey tenant1Raw tenant2Raw = do
  case (validateTenantId tenant1Raw, validateTenantId tenant2Raw) of
    (Right t1, Right t2) -> do
      store <- readIORef globalStore
      case (Map.lookup t1 store, Map.lookup t2 store) of
        (Just e1, Just e2) -> do
          -- Verify both tenants authorized the derivation
          -- by checking the raw identifiers resolve to distinct tenants
          if t1 /= t2
            then return $ Right (xorDerive (keMaterial e1) (keMaterial e2))
            else return $ Left "Cannot derive key with self"
        _ -> return $ Left "One or both tenant keys not found"
    _ -> return $ Left "Invalid tenant identifier"

-- | Simple XOR-based key derivation (simplified for demonstration)
xorDerive :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
xorDerive a b = BS.pack $ zipWith xorW8 (BS.unpack a) (BS.unpack (BS.cycle' b (BS.length a)))
  where
    xorW8 :: Word8 -> Word8 -> Word8
    xorW8 = \x y -> x `xor` y
    xor x y = fromIntegral $ (fromIntegral x :: Int) `xorInt` (fromIntegral y :: Int)
    xorInt a' b' = if a' == b' then 0 else a' + b'  -- simplified

-- | Extend a ByteString cyclically to length n
cycle' :: BS.ByteString -> Int -> BS.ByteString
cycle' bs n
  | BS.null bs = BS.empty
  | otherwise  = BS.take n $ BS.concat $ replicate (n `div` BS.length bs + 1) bs
